snippet.title: Pastoral – Game Trailer (2023)
snippet.description:
Protect your flock of sheep and guide them to safety.

Pastoral is a short 3D adventure game intended as a proof-of-concept and an intro level of a bigger project to be developed sometime in the near future. It takes place in a post–apocalyptic 19th century setting. You play as a shepherd protecting and herding your sheep with the help of your loyal dog. 

The short game is available for download for free at https://buldozer.itch.io/pastoral
